findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy=none, pct=100, rua=true

findings.deal_impact: Domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud, increasing payment-diversion and phishing risk; enforcement is a common insurer and customer-security questionnaire item.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC through monitored quarantine to p=reject, verifying all senders and DKIM/SPF alignment first.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier=~all, lookup_count=2

findings.deal_impact: Soft-fail SPF weakens sender authentication and compounds the DMARC enforcement gap, sustaining spoofing and fraud exposure.

remediation.summary: Audit authorised senders, then change SPF qualifier from ~all to -all in coordination with DMARC enforcement.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

evidence.excerpt: DNSSEC DS query returned enabled=false for brightwaterfleet.example.

findings.deal_impact: Unsigned DNS increases cache-poisoning/redirection risk for web and email traffic; usually a low-effort hygiene gap for diligence.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC signing at the registrar/DNS provider and verify the DS record chain.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: Risky hostname pattern=vpn; first_seen=2023-02-11, last_seen=2026-09-30; risky_hostnames_count=4
Risky hostname pattern=jenkins|old; first_seen=2021-06-03, last_seen=2026-08-14; risky_hostnames_count=4
Risky hostname pattern=staging; first_seen=2024-01-20, last_seen=2026-10-01; risky_hostnames_count=4
Risky hostname pattern=legacy; first_seen=2019-11-05, last_seen=2026-07-22; risky_hostnames_count=4

findings.deal_impact: Public VPN, legacy Jenkins, staging API, and legacy portal names widen the attack surface and suggest unpatched or weakly governed systems needing pre-close validation.

remediation.summary: Inventory each named host, confirm business need, patch/restrict access with MFA and allowlisting, or decommission legacy/staging systems.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

evidence.excerpt: Certificate Transparency query returned unique_hostnames=47, exceeding the >40 rule threshold, with risky_hostnames_count=4.

findings.deal_impact: 47 public hostnames for a 201-1000 employee company suggests asset sprawl that may outpace inventory and patch governance.

remediation.summary: Reconcile CT hostnames against the authoritative asset inventory and retire or formally risk-accept orphaned hosts.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: tls_support TLSv1.0=true, TLSv1.1=true, TLSv1.2=true; tls_versions=[TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2]; status_code=200

findings.deal_impact: Deprecated TLS on the www host exposes users to protocol downgrade weaknesses and may fail customer or payment security requirements.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 at the www endpoint, retaining TLSv1.2+ with current cipher configuration.

findings.title: HSTS not set

evidence.excerpt: headers strict-transport-security=null for the apex host; status_code=200
headers strict-transport-security=null for the www host; status_code=200

findings.deal_impact: Missing HSTS permits SSL-stripping/downgrade on first visits; a minor but easily evidenced web-hardening gap.

remediation.summary: Set a Strict-Transport-Security header with an appropriate max-age on apex and www responses.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001, vendor=ExampleGate, product=ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version=7.0.11, match_level=product, match_tier=appliance_exposed; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. KEV snapshot 2026-10-20.

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure to a known-exploited internet-facing SSL-VPN appliance (version not verified) could allow initial access; urgent patch/version verification is a deal-risk item.

remediation.summary: Urgently verify the ExampleGate SSL-VPN version against KEV, patch or isolate the appliance, enforce MFA, and review logs for exploitation.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified. Notice names Brightwater Fleet Systems, Inc. and its brightwaterfleet.example support portal; disclosed_within_months=14.

findings.deal_impact: A breach 14 months ago with ~3,100 individuals notified raises regulatory, notification-cost, customer-trust, and cyber-insurability diligence questions.

remediation.summary: Obtain incident report, root-cause and remediation evidence, regulatory correspondence, and confirm closure of corrective actions.
